Alexis Vega.summary: Alexis Vega is a Mexico left winger from Toluca who gives the national team direct dribbling, set-piece quality, and final-third invention.
Alexis Vega.note: Vega stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Alexis Vega.noteZh: 他的突出特点是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Alvaro Fidalgo.note: Fidalgo stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Alvaro Fidalgo.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Armando Gonzalez.note: González is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. He attacks the near-post lane before the marker can turn.
Armando Gonzalez.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。他也会在盯防者转身前冲向近门柱线路。

Brian Gutierrez.note: Watch Gutiérrez for receiving in tight spaces with his next action already planned. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Brian Gutierrez.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在狭小空间接球前就想好下一步。留意他如何先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Carlos Acevedo.note: Acevedo's edge is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Carlos Acevedo.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是提前站位后的快速反应。他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Cesar Huerta.note: Huerta stands out for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Cesar Huerta.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Cesar Montes.note: Montes's edge is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Cesar Montes.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Edson Alvarez.note: Watch Álvarez for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Edson Alvarez.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Erik Lira.note: Lira stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Erik Lira.noteZh: 他的突出特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Gilberto Mora.summary: Gilberto Mora is a Mexico attacking midfielder from Club Tijuana who adds teenage creativity, quick feet, and central chance creation.
Gilberto Mora.note: Mora is defined by creating a better angle for the next pass. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Gilberto Mora.noteZh: 他靠为下一脚传球制造更好的角度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Guillermo Martinez.note: Martínez's edge is giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Guillermo Martinez.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Guillermo Ochoa.note: Ochoa is defined by staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Guillermo Ochoa.noteZh: 他靠在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Israel Reyes.note: Reyes stands out for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Israel Reyes.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Jesus Gallardo.note: Gallardo stands out for making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk.
Jesus Gallardo.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Johan Vasquez.summary: Johan Vásquez is a Mexico centre-back from Genoa who gives the national team left-footed defending, aerial power, and Serie A-tested duels.
Johan Vasquez.note: Vásquez's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Johan Vasquez.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Jorge Sanchez.summary: Jorge Sánchez is a Mexico right-back from PAOK who adds wide defending, overlap timing, and national-team experience.
Jorge Sanchez.note: Sánchez is defined by seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Jorge Sanchez.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Julian Quinones.note: Quiñones is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward.
Julian Quinones.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。

Luis Chavez.note: Chávez stands out for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Luis Chavez.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Luis Romo.note: Romo stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Luis Romo.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Mateo Chavez.note: Watch Chávez for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Mateo Chavez.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Obed Vargas.note: Vargas's edge is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Obed Vargas.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Orbelin Pineda.note: Pineda is defined by creating a better angle for the next pass. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Orbelin Pineda.noteZh: 他靠为下一脚传球制造更好的角度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Raul Jimenez.note: Jiménez's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Raul Jimenez.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Raul Rangel.summary: Raúl Rangel is a Mexico goalkeeper from Guadalajara who gives the national team shot-stopping depth, reflex saves, and modern distribution.
Raul Rangel.note: Rangel's signature is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. He keeps his decisions calm when a sudden save is required.
Raul Rangel.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在提前站位后的快速反应上。他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。他也会突然需要扑救时仍能冷静判断。

Roberto Alvarado.note: Alvarado's edge is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Roberto Alvarado.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Santiago Gimenez.note: Giménez's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Santiago Gimenez.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。
